# CP-G1-STAND-01: STANDING humanoid reach under GRAVITY via a ROOT-WELD FixedJoint (the WORKING fixed base).
# A single UsdPhysics.FixedJoint PRIM welds the WORLD to the pelvis (the articulation ROOT) at its current pose
# -- the canonical "bolt the base to world". RAW-proven (cont.319ii-3): the pelvis HELD at 0.793 across 90
# physics steps WHILE the left arm actuated to its 60deg target (articulation ACTIVE). This is the mechanism
# that works after THREE that did not: the physxArticulation:fixedBase ATTRIBUTE is INERT post-add_reference
# (airtight A/B identical), two ankle (leaf) plant_feet welds OVER-CONSTRAIN the floating loop and explode, and
# the PhysicsFixedJointAPI SCHEMA on the root prim is malformed -> NaN. Under REAL gravity the welded base holds
# the biped up while the arm reaches a cube. Proof = arm DOFs in eyes.json row['j'] ramp to their targets AND the
# upper-body links do NOT collapse to Ground. rung 2 of the humanoid ladder: standing reach.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
# GRAVITY ON (this is the standing test, unlike CP-G1-ARM-01's zero-G) + GPU dynamics (the 29-DOF G1
# articulation NaN-explodes on CPU PhysX; GPU was the CP-G1-ARM-01 fix).
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": True, "gravity_magnitude": 9.81, "gravity_direction": [0.0, 0.0, -1.0]})

# Real Unitree G1 (29dof + hands). Default prim /g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0 maps ONTO /World/G1, so the
# articulation root lands at /World/G1/pelvis. Spawn pelvis at z=0.793 (G1 nominal standing hip height); the
# pelvis is fixed-based so the (dangling) feet only need to clear the ground.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/G1", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.793])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/G1", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Samples/Groot/Robots/g1_29dof_with_hand_rev_1_0.usd")

# ROOT-WELD: a single FixedJoint prim world->pelvis at the pelvis's current pose = the WORKING fixed base
# (RAW-proven: pelvis held 0.793 while the arm reached 60deg). A FixedJoint PRIM takes effect in the instantiator
# path (unlike the inert fixedBase attribute); one root anchor (vs two leaf-ankle welds) does not over-constrain.
run_usd_script(code="import omni.usd\nfrom pxr import UsdPhysics, UsdGeom, Usd, Sdf, Gf\nstage = omni.usd.get_context().get_stage()\npelvis = stage.GetPrimAtPath('/World/G1/pelvis')\nif not pelvis.IsValid():\n    print('STAND: ERROR pelvis missing at /World/G1/pelvis')\nelse:\n    m = UsdGeom.Xformable(pelvis).ComputeLocalToWorldTransform(Usd.TimeCode.Default())\n    pos = m.ExtractTranslation()\n    rot = m.ExtractRotationQuat()\n    fj = UsdPhysics.FixedJoint.Define(stage, '/World/G1_RootWeld')\n    fj.GetBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path('/World/G1/pelvis')])\n    fj.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(float(pos[0]), float(pos[1]), float(pos[2])))\n    fj.CreateLocalRot0Attr(Gf.Quatf(float(rot.GetReal()), Gf.Vec3f(*[float(x) for x in rot.GetImaginary()])))\n    fj.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n    fj.CreateLocalRot1Attr(Gf.Quatf(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))\n    print('STAND: root-weld FixedJoint world->pelvis at ' + str([round(float(x), 3) for x in pos]))\n", description="Root-weld the G1 (FixedJoint world->pelvis at its current pose) so it stands under gravity")

# STATIC PEDESTAL so the graspable cube rests at the reach height (a free cube would free-fall to the floor).
# Collision-only static Cube (no RigidBody) -> holds the cube up; named Pedestal so scene_eyes does not track it.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.405], scale=[0.06, 0.06, 0.41])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# Graspable cube inside the LEFT-hand reach envelope (0.419 m from shoulder), resting on the pedestal top.
# RigidBody + name Cube_1 so scene_eyes auto-tracks it (scene_eyes.py:159 _DELIV_PREFIX includes 'Cube').
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.30, 0.18, 0.87], size=0.05)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# DRIVE THE LEFT ARM toward the cube (DEGREES; set_attribute does a raw attr.Set, limits stored in degrees;
# pre-configured drives stiffness 1e7, maxForce 25). Joints are NESTED in the kinematic chain (pxr-verified).
#   /World/G1/torso_link/left_shoulder_pitch_joint     -> +50 deg (forward/down sweep; limit [-177,153])
#   /World/G1/left_shoulder_yaw_link/left_elbow_joint  -> +60 deg (flexes forearm onto cube; limit [-60,120])
# PROOF = eyes.json row['j'] for these DOFs ramps toward the targets while pelvis-z holds (stood, not toppled).
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/torso_link/left_shoulder_pitch_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=50.0)
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/G1/left_shoulder_yaw_link/left_elbow_joint", attr_name="drive:angular:physics:targetPosition", value=60.0)
